items.stem: Under the accruals concept, revenue and the costs of earning it should be:

options.text: Recognised in the period in which they are earned and incurred, not when cash moves
options.rationale: Correct: accruals accounting matches income and expense to the period they relate to, independent of cash flow.

options.text: Recognised only when cash is received or paid
options.rationale: That describes cash accounting, not the accruals concept.

options.text: Recognised only at the end of the entity's life
options.rationale: Periodic accounts are prepared regularly, not only at the end.
Estimates are permitted and often required under accruals accounting.

items.explanation: Correct: accruals accounting matches income and expense to the period they relate to, independent of cash flow.

options.rationale: Correct: the expense (purchases) is debited and the liability (payables) is credited.

No cash moves on a credit purchase.
This records a cash sale, not a credit purchase.
